description: This file is a CMake script containing functions for configuring header-only libraries and packages, primarily involved in build setup and configuration generation for a software project.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs CMake configuration files for a header-only library target, handling dependencies and versioning.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs package configuration files (like .pc files) for a library target, including compile options and include directories.
